# Data
## Initial clustering
```{r}
general_data <- read_in_general_data(proband_type = "current_cases_new_cidi",
                                     cytokine_version = "additional_correct",
                                     healthy_control_version = "strict",
                                     add_lifetime_cases = FALSE)

set_defaults <- function(
    compare_means_test = "kruskal.test",
    add_lifetime_cases = FALSE,
    add_healthy_controls = TRUE
) {
  list(
    compare_means_test = compare_means_test,
    add_lifetime_cases = add_lifetime_cases,
    add_healthy_controls = add_healthy_controls
  )
}

# phenotypes, cytokines, RNAseq
res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna <- read.table("01_res_phenotypes_cytokines_rna_seed_max_iter_10000/k4/clusters.tsv",
                       header = TRUE)
res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna$label <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna$label + 1
res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna %>% 
  rename(ID = sample, cluster = label)
```

```{r}
                       header = TRUE)
res_sumo_3_cyt_rna_cov$label <- res_sumo_3_cyt_rna_cov$label + 1
```

```{r}
res_sumo_3_pheno_cell_cyt_rna <- read.table("01_res_phenotypes_celltypes_14_cytokines_rna_seed_max_iter_10000/k3/clusters.tsv",

res_sumo_3_pheno_cell_cyt_rna$label <- res_sumo_3_pheno_cell_cyt_rna$label + 1
```

# Statistics
Test the distribution of several phenotypes across the clusters and between the
cases and controls without a DSM-IV diagnosis.

## Cases vs. controls
Age
```{r}
ids_case_control <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna %>% 
  mutate(status = "case") %>% 
  select(-cluster) %>% 
  bind_rows(general_data$control_ids %>% mutate(status = "control"))

test_data_age <- general_data$age %>% 
  right_join(ids_case_control, by = "ID")

test_data_age %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sd = sd(age))

t.test(test_data_age$age ~ test_data_age$status)
```

Sex
```{r}
test_data_sex <- general_data$imputed_data %>% 
  right_join(ids_case_control, by = "ID") %>% 
  filter(.imp == 1) %>% 
  select(ID, status, sex)

fisher.test(x = test_data_sex$sex, y = test_data_sex$status)
```

BMI
```{r}
test_data_bmi <- general_data$bmi %>% 
  right_join(ids_case_control, by = "ID")

test_data_bmi %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sd = sd(BMI, na.rm = TRUE))

t.test(test_data_bmi$BMI ~ test_data_bmi$status)
```

```{r}
generate_test(
```
```{r}
  type = "BDI_single",
  general_data = general_data,
  cluster_assignments = res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna,

) %>%
```

Correlation of CRP, age and BMI
```{r}
data_correlation_initial_clustering <- general_data$cytokine_uncorrected %>% 
  right_join(res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna, by = "ID")

# BMI & CRP
data_correlation_initial_clustering %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(
    cor = cor.test(BMI, hsCRP, use = "complete.obs")$estimate,
    p.value = cor.test(BMI, hsCRP, use = "complete.obs")$p.value
  )

# age & CRP
data_correlation_initial_clustering %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(
    cor = cor.test(age, hsCRP, use = "complete.obs")$estimate,
    p.value = cor.test(age, hsCRP, use = "complete.obs")$p.value
  )

# age & BMI
data_correlation_initial_clustering %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(
    cor = cor.test(age, BMI, use = "complete.obs")$estimate,
    p.value = cor.test(age, BMI, use = "complete.obs")$p.value
  )
```

Distribution of Become and Optima cohorts across clusters
```{r}
data_studies_initial_clustering <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna %>% 
  mutate(
    study = if_else(str_detect(ID, "^F"), "Become", "Optima")
  )

fisher.test(
  x = data_studies_initial_clustering$cluster,
  y = data_studies_initial_clustering$study
)
```
Exclude the MIDS cluster:
```{r}
data_studies_initial_clustering_wo_mids <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna %>% 
  mutate(
    study = if_else(str_detect(ID, "^F"), "Become", "Optima")
  ) %>% 
  filter(cluster != 1)

fisher.test(
  x = data_studies_initial_clustering_wo_mids$cluster,
  y = data_studies_initial_clustering_wo_mids$study
)
```

ECG
```{r}
generate_test(
  type = "ECG",
  general_data = general_data,

  QC_filtering = "with_exclusions",

)

generate_test(
  type = "ECG",
  general_data = general_data,
  cluster_assignments = res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna,
  # with_exclusions means that the participants with low quality data were excluded
  QC_filtering = "with_exclusions",
  include_controls = TRUE
)
```

Imaging
```{r}
test_imaging_thickness_ancova <- generate_test(
  type = "imaging_ancova",
  general_data = general_data,
  cluster_assignments = res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna,
  variable_type = "thickness_revised",
  model_type = "without_age2",
  include_controls = TRUE
)

test_imaging_volume_ancova <- generate_test(
  type = "imaging_ancova",
  general_data = general_data,
  cluster_assignments = res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna,
  variable_type = "volumina",
  model_type = "without_age2",
  include_controls = TRUE
)

results_4_cluster_final_version <- bind_rows(
  test_imaging_thickness_ancova,
  test_imaging_volume_ancova %>% filter(variable %in% c("LatVent", "hippo"))
) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(term, "^cluster")) %>% 
  mutate(
    p_value_adjusted = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  )
```

Calculate the mean BMI values per group:
```{r}
general_data$cytokine_uncorrected %>% 
  right_join(res_sumo_3_pheno_cell_cyt_rna, by = "ID") %>%
```

## Holdout sample vs clustering sample

```{r}
ids_initial_replication <- res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna %>% 
  mutate(status = "clustering") %>% 
  select(-cluster) %>% 
  bind_rows(data_replication_top10 %>% select(ID) %>% mutate(status = "replication"))

test_data_age_replication <- general_data$age %>% 
  right_join(ids_initial_replication, by = "ID")

test_data_age_replication %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sd = sd(age))

t.test(test_data_age_replication$age ~ test_data_age_replication$status)
```

```{r}
test_data_sex_replication <- general_data$imputed_data %>% 
  filter(.imp == 1) %>% 
  select(ID, sex) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    data_replication_top10 %>% select(ID, sex)
  ) %>% 
  right_join(ids_initial_replication, by = "ID")

fisher.test(x = test_data_sex_replication$sex, y = test_data_sex_replication$status)
```


```{r}
test_data_bmi_replication <- general_data$bmi %>% 
  bind_rows(
    data_replication_top10 %>% select(ID, BMI)
  ) %>% 
  right_join(ids_initial_replication, by = "ID")

test_data_bmi_replication %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sd = sd(BMI, na.rm = TRUE))

t.test(test_data_bmi_replication$BMI ~ test_data_bmi_replication$status)
```

```{r}
test_data_bdi_replication <- general_data$bdi_sumscores %>%
  select(ID, BDI_total) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    data_replication_top10 %>% select(ID, BDI_total)
  ) %>% 
  right_join(ids_initial_replication, by = "ID")

test_data_bdi_replication %>% 
  group_by(status) %>% 
  summarise(sd = sd(BDI_total, na.rm = TRUE))

t.test(test_data_bdi_replication$BDI_total ~ test_data_bdi_replication$status)
```

```{r}
test_data_mdd_replication <- mdd_diagnosis %>%

fisher.test(x = test_data_mdd_replication$has_depression_dysthymia, y = test_data_mdd_replication$status)
```

```{r}
test_data_medication_replication <- general_data$medication_data %>%
```

## Infliximab data

Check which genes of the DEGs show a pattern that distinguished the HIRDS clusters
(median of both HIRDS clusters are higher or lower than from both MIDS and LIRDS).

```{r}
mehta_degs_hirds_distinction <- generate_report(type = "RNA_HIRDS_distribution",
                                                general_data = general_data,
                                                cluster_assignments = res_sumo_4_pheno_cyt_rna,
                                                rna_type = "standard",
                                                gene_list = overlapping_genes %>% filter(timepoint == "baseline") %>%  distinct(ensembl_gene_id) %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id))

dim(mehta_degs_hirds_distinction) # 22 genes
```
